question_summary: Resolve clash at Gridline D/7 where the concrete grade beam conflicts with the underground electrical duct bank, plumbing sanitary main, and mechanical condensate drain so fabrication can proceed.
deadline_text: A response within three weeks would be appreciated.
routing_rationale: The clash requires multidisciplinary coordination and an issued coordination sketch, which the Architect of Record is best positioned to lead with structural and MEP consultants.
